1.why: Two contrast options and two non-contrast; 'On the other hand' is the only plain contrast that needs no conditional antecedent, unlike 'Otherwise'/'In that case'.

2.why: Only option that states a purpose ('to rule out the possibility'); the others report results or a conclusion.

3.why: Only option that generalizes with a proportion and breadth ('11 of the 12 vents... three different oceans, indicating'); others are single facts.

4.why: Set holds two similarity/contrast cheap options and 'Indeed'; 'In turn' is the only consequence-chain marker, the usual key shape here.

5.why: Guess: 'Accordingly' is the only result marker against one similarity, one substitution and one concession.

6.why: Guess: 'For instance' is the only exemplification marker in a set of concession/simultaneity/result.

7.why: Only option answering 'why it matters' with scale of impact ('two-thirds of the world where reliable freezing is unavailable'); others describe the problem or the mechanism.

8.why: '9 of the 10... indicating the effect is characteristic' is the hedged proportion; D self-destructs with 'must be... every structure the Romans ever built'.

9.why: Only hedged option ('modest... in some settings, though the effects varied'); C and D overgeneralize, B dismisses.

10.why: Only option covering the whole progression ('Successive innovations steadily lowered... until roll film in 1888'); B, C, D are single steps.

11.why: Only option naming the significance and forward implication ('more than doubling the previous record... opens the door'); others give process or background.

12.why: Guess: 'In other words' is the only restatement marker among simultaneity, contrast and result.

13.why: Pure chance - all four are the same sentence with swapped percentage and substrate; no basis without the notes.

14.why: Guess: 'Consequently' is the only result marker; contrast, similarity and specification are the standard three distractors.

15.why: Guess: 'Even so' is the only concessive against similarity, simultaneity and restatement.

16.why: Guess: 'In fact' is the only intensifier; the others are substitution, simultaneity and result.

17.why: Only option giving stakes/harm ('1.3 million deaths a year... could again become deadly'); others give causes or drug-pipeline background.

18.why: Near chance - identical frame with swapped counts; picked the mid-range sample size and reduction as least extreme.

19.why: Only option stating the finding itself ('fly nonstop across the Atlantic, up to 2,700 km'); others give method, attrition or background.

20.why: Guess: 'For instance' is the only exemplification marker against summary, comparison and dismissal.

21.why: Only option with explicit ordering ('in order: first earthquakes, then ground bulging, then a spike in sulfur gas').

22.why: Four options share the frame; 'four studios in a single city' is the canonical sampling-scope limitation, the strongest generalizability threat.

23.why: Near chance among parallel frames; 'the three shelters nearest the village center' most directly undercuts the stated 'village-wide' claim.

24.why: Guess: 'As a result' is the only causal marker against contrast, similarity and example.
